aboutGame.title: What is Agefield High: Rock the School?
paragraphs: Agefield High: Rock the School is a single-player open-world action-adventure from Refugium Games. Set in the early 2000s, it follows new student Sam as he joins Kale and Axel in a plan to rebel, find love, and leave school as a legend.

Its compact world spans the school campus, two neighborhoods, the town center, and the countryside. Players can attend or skip class, complete story and side missions, earn cash, fight rivals, ride bikes, customize Sam, and steer the story toward one of two endings.

modules.name: Agefield High: Rock the School Beginner Guide
modules.description: Start Sam's senior year with the core systems explained in a practical order. Learn how school attendance, free exploration, pocket money, missions, shops, and customization fit together.

highlights.detail: Learn the weekday schedule; attending class keeps Sam in lessons until the afternoon.
Balance attendance against skipping class, since good grades and side missions both provide ways to earn cash.
Explore the campus, two neighborhoods, town center, and countryside outside lessons and main missions.
Spend earnings at shops on bicycles, clothes, hairstyles, tattoos, and accessories.

highlights.detail: Attend lessons and earn good grades to receive pocket money.

Unlock every bicycle to earn the Bike enthusiast achievement.

items.question: What is Agefield High: Rock the School?
items.answer: Agefield High: Rock the School is a single-player open-world action-adventure from Refugium Games. It follows Sam through his final months at school in an early-2000s setting filled with classes, missions, exploration, fights, friendships, and choices.

items.question: When was Agefield High: Rock the School released?
items.answer: Agefield High: Rock the School was released for Windows PC through Steam on August 12, 2026.

items.question: What can you do in Agefield High: Rock the School?
items.answer: In Agefield High: Rock the School, you can attend or skip class, complete main and side missions, explore four connected areas, earn cash, fight rivals, ride bicycles, shop for customization items, and shape Sam's ending.

items.question: Which classes are in Agefield High: Rock the School?
items.answer: Agefield High: Rock the School includes English, Math, Geography, German, and Music classes. Attending lessons and earning good grades provides pocket money, while skipping class leaves more time for exploration and side missions.

items.question: How long is Agefield High: Rock the School?
items.answer: Agefield High: Rock the School has 32 main missions, 15 side missions or activities, and an estimated story length of 8–10 hours.

items.question: How many endings and achievements are in Agefield High: Rock the School?
items.answer: Agefield High: Rock the School has two endings and 11 Steam achievements. The achievements cover both prom outcomes, savings, bicycles, side activities, and six collectible sets.
